title: Media Inquiry: Channel 10 — launched from behind your hangar?

fields.message: We have bystander video that shows the drone taking off from behind the Harwick UAS hangar. Is it yours? We go live at 12:30.

instructorNote: Watch for no denial of what the video may show.

snapshot.title: Channel 10 News: Drone Video Inquiry — Fairgrounds Crowd

fields.message: This is Channel 10 News, reporting from the fairgrounds. We have a video from a bystander showing a drone with a red light near the west grandstand. It appears to be a Group aircraft. Is this true? We’re on air in 10 minutes. Call us at 585-555-0160.
fields.deadline: ON AIR IN 10 MIN — GOING LIVE AT 12:20

snapshot.instructorNote: This is a high-pressure media inquiry. The PIO must not respond directly; the call must be logged and forwarded to Corporate Communications. Watch for any attempt to issue a public statement.
